name: Student Community Service Days
what_you_do: Help care for the gardens for two hours in the morning and earn service hours for school. Staff teach you what to do.
who_can_apply: Students ages 12 to 15. If you are 16 or older, join the regular Community Service Days instead.
pay_detail: Free. Volunteer service hours, no pay.
deadline_text: Next Student Community Service Day: Nov 14, 2026, 9 to 11 a.m. Next Community Service Day for ages 16 and older: Nov 7, 2026, 9 to 11 a.m. Later dates are on the events calendar.
how_to_apply: Email volunteer@descansogardens.org to save your spot. You must sign a waiver. For other roles, fill out an interest form and go to a short talk.
notes: Check the events calendar for the next date after this one. The 16 and older days ask that you can lift, bend and stand for long periods.
